minimum_budget_request.formula: 3 seeds x 5 worlds x 3 continual-learning mechanisms x 8 feedbacks
minimum_budget_request.selective_update_source: reuse frozen historical ZERO-4 G2 two-group gate per seed; ZERO-6 does not train it
minimum_budget_request.development_gate: for each paired seed, ordinary-SGD mean per-skill development balanced-accuracy gain across A-E >= 0.05; otherwise stop before sealed evaluation
minimum_budget_request.limitation: eight feedbacks/world is a screening length; skill acquisition is not yet established
